title: Understanding Matrix Dimensions
text: When dealing with matrices in OLS, it's important to remember that the design matrix $X$ includes all the features plus an intercept. This means if you have $p$ features, $X$ will have $p+1$ columns. Can you visualize how this affects the shape of $X$?

title: Matrix Shape Check
text: Consider the number of observations $n$ and the number of features $p$. If $X$ is supposed to include an intercept, what should be the number of columns in $X$?
